summary:
Frontend-only testing of the chat table PDF export bug fix (V50.z317). Attempted end-to-end verification of TEST1 (msg-pdf-btn popup HTML), TEST2 (fullscreen table-full-export-pdf popup + A4 single-page assertion) and TEST3 (regression: non-table message). BLOCKED at authentication: UI login via [data-testid="auth-submit-button"] fires POST /api/auth/login successfully (backend curl works, returns valid JWT), but the client then sets auth-error = '[object Object]' and remains on /login. Token pre-seeding into localStorage (key 'auth_token_v1') got the app past /login once (redirected to /landing) but the ENTRA CTA landing page interrupts, and a subsequent direct navigation to /home still bounced back to /login (SecureStore-backed session invalidation on web). Therefore no popups could be inspected. Static code review of the fix was performed and looks correct: (a) chatExport.exportConversationPdf routes web through printHtmlWeb(html) which opens a dedicated window.open('_blank') and writes ONLY the built HTML — no window.print() on the main chat page; (b) when tables are present, buildTablesOnlyHtml is used which contains only
,

title

,
Aggiornato al
, and — no .msg / .body wrappers; (c) fullscreen path (ChatTableExport.doExport('pdf','full')) also uses printHtmlWeb via tableToPdfBase64, and tableToHtml runs through fitTableLayout to shrink font/pad down to 6px so 19 rows fit A4 portrait; (d) non-table messages fall back to buildHtml() which does include .msg/.body — as required by TEST3.

ui_bugs.issue: auth-error state is rendered as '[object Object]' when POST /api/auth/login succeeds via UI submit (curl to same endpoint returns 200 with token+user). The catch/setErr likely receives an object (e.g. Error or response payload) instead of a string. Blocks all UI testing that requires login. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:101,193

integration_issues.issue: Even after obtaining JWT via curl and injecting it into localStorage under 'auth_token_v1', navigating directly to /home redirects back to /login. Suggests the token key on web is different (e.g. under an AsyncStorage prefix) or auth context requires an additional 'user' cache entry. Blocks reproducible headless auth for automation.

action_items: Fix login error rendering: cast err to string (err?.message || String(err)) in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx so real cause surfaces; then re-run this playbook.
Confirm SecureStore/AsyncStorage web key(s) used for token so agent can pre-seed a session; alternatively expose a test hook to loginWithSession(token,user) from a debug URL.

After login is testable, re-run the three assertions defined in the request: TEST1 (msg-pdf popup contains <table + 'Aggiornato al' + class=brand + <h1, and does NOT contain class=msg / class=body / assistant non-table text; main chat page did not print), TEST2 (fullscreen popup → page.pdf A4 gives exactly 1 /Type /Page match AND document.body.scrollHeight < 1123), TEST3 (non-table message popup still contains class=body + class=brand).
critical_code_review_comments: chatExport.ts:174 printHtmlWeb(html) correctly bypasses expo-print's web = window.print() bug — good.
chatExport.ts:127 buildTablesOnlyHtml intentionally omits any .msg/.body/.foot wrappers around the table so only brand+h1+sub+table are printed — matches spec.

ChatTableExport.tsx:203 fitTableLayout stops at font 6px; for pathological huge tables fits=false and page-break-inside becomes 'auto' (multi-page). This is acceptable but the request expects 1 page for 19 rows — verified by inspection: 19 rows × ~10-12px row-height fits ~700-800px available on A4 portrait (842px page - 2×20 margin - ~120 header/title/sub), so fits=true at initial 10px.
ChatBubbles.tsx:339 msg-pdf-btn correctly calls exportConversationPdf([msg], …) with only the single assistant message — good, no whole-conversation leak.
chatExport.ts:161 fetchTableBrandHeader().catch → falls back gracefully; brandName falls back to userName which then feeds brandBlock — good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via UI is currently broken on this preview host: auth-error is rendered as '[object Object]' even though POST /api/auth/login returns 200 for test@dalpastro.it / Test1234! (curl works). Pre-seeding localStorage 'auth_token_v1' briefly lets the app reach /landing but not the tabs. Once login is fixed, use these testIDs: assistant-fab (FAB), assistant-send, table-export-btn, table-fullscreen-btn, table-full-export-pdf, table-fullscreen-close, msg-pdf-btn. Use context.expect_page() around each PDF button click to capture the dedicated popup, then inspect popup.content(). For TEST2 count pages with await popup.pdf(format='A4', prefer_css_page_size=True, print_background=True) then regex /Type\s*/Page[^s].
rca_of_issue: Bug is in login error handling, not in the PDF-export feature under review. The PDF-export code paths (printHtmlWeb + buildTablesOnlyHtml + tableToHtml/fitTableLayout) look correct per static analysis and match the spec; runtime confirmation still pending.
